issues.quote: How I used to long for them at times!
Throw out the litterers along with the litter.

strengths.quote: I am sick of being an inn where those creatures forever jostle, shout, bustle and drop their litter.
that beautiful brother of death came and took me to himself
the iron hand clack its bones in vain
like splinters and straw on spring floodwaters
clickety-clack-clack... our division was stationed there then... clickety-clack-clack...
